messages:
Renee (Finance): Heads up — HelioMed spotted an unexpected platform fee true-up on their private deployment renewal. Can billing confirm what's going on?
Omar (Billing): Looking now. I see two entries: PLATFORM_FEE_ANNUAL and PLATFORM_FEE_TRUEUP. The true-up amount seems to reflect usage-based SKU that should have been waived per their invoice credit last quarter.
Zoe (Customer Ops): They had a manual goodwill credit Q4 (ticket CS-4412) applied after outage. Notes say 'waive next true-up'. Looks like that flag didn't persist into this billing run.
Tarek (Revenue): If we don't waive, this will reduce our net retention % on the account in the close. We should honor the waiver per CS note and our SLA credit policy. What's the dollar amount?
Omar (Billing): Draft of invoice lines:
```
line,desc,amount
201,PLATFORM_FEE_ANNUAL,3600
202,PLATFORM_FEE_TRUEUP,1800
203,WAIVED_GOODWILL_CREDIT,-1800
```
The system generated line 202 and also auto-applied the waiver as line 203 but both are present so net is +3600 not +3600-1800 = +1800. Looks like waiver is an invoice-level credit that should offset the true-up but our aggregator double-counted.
Renee (Finance): So customer paid net 3600 but expected 1800. That's a 1800 overcharge. Proposal: issue credit memo for 1800 and regenerate renewal so ARR matches expected. Also file BILL-8620 to fix aggregator offset logic. Approve?
Tarek (Revenue): Approve. Also request we mark the account flag so future runs skip auto-true-up for this customer for one billing cycle.
Zoe (Customer Ops): I'll notify HelioMed that we're issuing a $1,800 credit and will send corrected invoice today. They'll appreciate the proactive note.
Omar (Billing): Creating credit memo CM-6019 and corrected invoice now. BillingBot: Credit memo CM-6019 created at 2034001250 by Omar.
Renee (Finance): Add note to renewal MRR file: "one-time true-up waived per outage credit" so bookings team doesn't double count. Close once invoice sent.
